clip_prefix.why: His retargeted clips and blendspaces were made by hand before the '<short>_' convention existed; renaming them would break GoldenDiff.MTKhaimera, Verify.ClipVaries and every shot that names them.

grip.why: The locomotion is retargeted from the mannequin's unarmed clips, so every bone under a hand (fingers, weapon_l/weapon_r) carries an open hand around nothing. The hero's own Jog_Fwd frame 0 holds the grip (not Idle: Paragon's Idle is an additive, which collapses evaluated alone). dyn_abp layers each hand's subtree from it.
